# Evrim Ağacı

> > Turkey's leading popular science and education platform, founded by Çağrı Mert Bakırcı, covering evolution, astronomy, climate science, psychology, and critical thinking.

Evrim Ağacı (Evolution Tree) is a comprehensive Turkish-language science communication platform featuring daily science news, educational articles, APOD astronomy content, and books on evolution and skepticism. The platform collaborates with researchers from institutions like ODTÜ and Texas Tech Üniversitesi, with notable contributors including geologist Ferit Görür and researcher Okan Alver.

## Key Topics

- Evrim Kuramı ve Mekanizmaları (Evolution Theory and Mechanisms)
- Evrim Ağacı - Science Communication Platform
- Çağrı Mert Bakırcı - Founder & Science Communicator
- Ferit Görür - Geologist & Contributor
- Kara Delikler (Black Holes)
- İklim Felaketleri (Climate Disasters)
- Katil Balinalar (Killer Whales)
- Evren Genişleme (Universe Expansion)
- Hayvan Davranışları (Animal Behavior)
- Şüphecinin El Kitabı (Skeptic's Handbook)
- ODTÜ (Middle East Technical University)
- Yamyamlık (Cannibalism)
- Evolutionary Robotics
- Bilim Haberleri (Science News)
- Critical Thinking & Manipulation Psychology
